name: caddy-l4-public
description: Public-edge Caddy-L4 SNI mux on oci-analytics. Owns the public 0.0.0.0:443. SNI allowlist *.diegonmarcos.com → TCP-relay to gcp-proxy via wg-public (10.1.0.2:443; oci-analytics is the hub at 10.1.0.1, gcp-proxy is the spoke at 10.1.0.2). Unmatched SNI gets TCP RST. Pure layer-4 — does NOT terminate TLS; the gcp-proxy Caddy edge still handles all cert + routing logic. This makes oci-analytics THE single public-edge VM per the wg-public hardening design (operator policy 2026-05-23): gcp-proxy stays fully private, c3-public-api remains the only application surface directly served from oci-analytics; everything else either flows through this L4 relay to gcp-proxy or peers join wg-public to reach 10.1.0.2:443 directly.
_doc_relay_target: 10.1.0.2:443 = gcp-proxy wg-public IP (spoke). 10.1.0.1 is oci-analytics itself (hub). Source: cloud-data.native.wg_public.peers[name=gcp-proxy].wg_ip. Hardcoded in Caddyfile because caddy-l4's tls sni matcher with wildcard *.diegonmarcos.com and the gcp-proxy wg-public IP are architectural constants — if they move, update the Caddyfile explicitly; not worth a templating layer for a 2-liner config.
